description: This Java class, LogWrapper, is a helper that wraps Android's native Log utility to facilitate logging within a chain of LogNodes, enabling flexible log output targeting various destinations.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that implements LogNode and wraps Android's Log utility to send log messages to the next node in a chain, adding support for chaining and flexible logging.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent after this node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message with specified priority, tag, and optional Throwable, forwarding to Android's Log and passing along the chain.
